campaign_name: PR-PLAY T05 Authorized Clue Publication Composition Repair
purpose: Prevent unrelated synthetic momentum filler after resolver-selected information, preserving candidate elaboration and immutable acceptance.
executive_summary: Original T05 HTTP publication improves: The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates. Someone jabs at the board in Cinderwatch Gate District, impatient with anyone who reads too long. → You inspect notice board. The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates. Traced source: scene-momentum stock append, now declined for selected disclosures. Only response_policy_enforcement.py changes. Same 398 tests: 378 passed / 20 known failures before and after; 15 new tests pass; combined 393/20. All three closed inspections pass; other eleven turn publications unchanged. Zero live provider calls. Bounded implementation repair, not broad gameplay acceptance.

production: game/response_policy_enforcement.py::enforce_scene_momentum only; existing selected-information metadata declines synthetic stock append before hard validation/sealing.
validation: 15 new composition cases; same historical selections and 17 pre-seal tests; unchanged original twelve-turn HTTP scenario.
tooling: Cycle-owned guarded runners, raw stage/state captures, result comparison and archive seal.
documentation: Ten reports and prepended NEXT_SESSION with exact historical suffix.
generated_artifacts: Before/after evidence, source hashes, cycle-only diff and fresh review archive.

testing.focused: New tests 7 pass / 8 fail before to 15/0 after, same test source. Three closed inspections and 17 authority tests pass.
testing.broader: Same 398: 378/20 before and after. Existing expanded 381: 361/20. Combined 413: 393/20. No collection errors/skips.
testing.runtime_validation: Original T05 HTTP path: clue intact, no stock append, normal hard validity, digest and accepted/published/pointer identity. Other eleven published turns unchanged; all routing/disclosures/resolver state/scenes/refusal outcomes preserved. Seven conversational handoff controls and AT-OPT-06 controls pass.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Zero live calls, retries or provider token additions. External network blocked; isolated storage.
testing.new_regressions: None. Twenty baseline failure identities and normalized diagnostics match.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Twelve obsolete public-resolution assertions, stew mismatch, four refusal/publication cases including portal exception, three unrelated KeyErrors.

campaign_specific: Only synthetic momentum selection for resolver-selected new information is repaired; arbitrary existing candidate prose is not reclassified.
pre_existing: T01/T07 missing narration; T02 unhelpful NPC; T04/T06 physical completion; T08 generic acknowledgment; T10 trade; T12 operational refusal and twenty baseline failures remain.

missing_concepts: No general relevance classifier or new narrative subsystem introduced.
does_not_prove: Broad playability, independent held-out generalization, full-suite acceptance, live-provider behavior or Gameplay Benchmark improvement.
recommended_next_step: Exactly one proposed next action: investigate T04 notice-board physical-action completion through its existing local-interaction owner; preserve T05. Do not begin automatically.
self_contained_review_test: Independently reopen archive; verify ten reports, original T05 before/after traces and publication, same regression failures, source/evidence manifest hashes and preserved NEXT_SESSION history.
